summary: VSE Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that its Board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share, payable October 29, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 15, 2026. The dividend was approved on August 4, 2026, with a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a capital return program or strategic event. No unusual terms, recommendations, or structural details are present. The filing is purely informational and does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation category.
